title: Standing on the Promises
lyrics: [G]Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
[C]Thru eternal ages let His [G]praises ring;
Glory in the highest I will shout and sing,
Standing on the [Am]promis-[D7]es of [G]God[C]. [G] [D7]
[G]Standing, [C]stand-[Em]ing,
[D]Standing on the promises of [G]God my [C]Sav-[G]ior;
[G]Standing, [C]stand-[Am]ing,
I'm [G]standing on the promi-[D7]ses of [G]God.
[G]Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
[C]Through eternal ages let His prais[G]es ring;
Glory in the highest I will shout and sing,
Standing on the [D7]promises of [G]God.[C] [G] [G7]
[G]Standing, [C]standing,
[D7]Standing on the promises of [G]God my [C]Savi[G]our;
Standing, [C]standing, I'm [G]standing on the promis[D7]es of [G]God.
Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.
Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.
